system_prompt:
You are an agent that completes user tasks by calling the provided tools. Call tools whenever they are needed to satisfy the user's request.
If none of the available tools can fulfil the request, say so instead of guessing. If the request is missing a value that a tool requires, ask the user for it.
Keep calling tools until the current request is fully handled. When you have nothing left to call, reply in natural language summarising what you did — a message with no tool call ends the current turn.

Work in an explicit reason-act loop. Every time you call a tool, begin that SAME message with the literal label 'Thought:' followed by one or two sentences — what you know, what you still need, and which tool to call next — then make the tool call(s) in that same message.
A Thought with no tool call attached ends the current turn. After each tool result, any further tool call again begins with a 'Thought:' label in that same message.

messages.content: I just arrived at the office and want to know the current market status to plan my trading activities for the day. Update the market status with the current time so I can adjust my strategy accordingly.

content: Thought: I need to first get the current time and then use that to update the market status. I'll start by retrieving the current time.
The current market status is now updated to "Open" based on the current time of 10:30 AM. You can proceed with your trading activities for the day as the market is currently open.

messages.content: I noticed some promising trends and want to proceed with a 'Buy' order for 100 shares of AAPL at a price of $150 each. Let's ensure the order is placed correctly.

content: Thought: I need to place a buy order for 100 shares of AAPL at $150 per share. I'll use the place_order tool for this.

Your buy order for 100 shares of AAPL at $150 per share has been successfully placed. Here are the details:

- Order ID: 12446
- Order Type: Buy
- Status: Pending
- Price: $150.00 per share
- Quantity: 100 shares

The order is currently pending execution. You can monitor its status using the order ID.

messages.content: I received a notification about the order placement but want a detailed look at the transaction. Provide me with the full details of my recent order.

content: Thought: I need to retrieve the detailed information of the recent order using the order ID provided earlier (12446). I'll use the get_order_details tool for this.

Here are the full details of your recent order:

- Order ID: 12446
- Order Type: Buy
- Stock Symbol: AAPL
- Price: $150.00 per share
- Quantity: 100 shares
- Status: Open

Your order is currently open and pending execution. You can continue to monitor its status as it progresses.

messages.content: Upon further consideration, I think it's better to hold off on this purchase. Please cancel my recent order for the AAPL shares.

content: Thought: I need to cancel the recent order for AAPL shares using the order ID (12446). I'll use the cancel_order tool for this.

Your order for AAPL shares has been successfully cancelled. Here are the details:

- Order ID: 12446
- New Status: Cancelled

The purchase has been halted, and no shares will be bought. You can now reconsider your strategy or place a new order if needed.

messages.content: I've handled all necessary trading decisions for today, and I want to make sure my account is securely logged out. Confirm my logout from the trading system.

content: Thought: I need to log out the user from the trading system to ensure account security. I'll use the trading_logout tool for this.
You have been successfully logged out of the trading system. Your account is now secure, and no further trading activities can be performed until you log back in. Have a great day!
